description_zh: Cruise AV 在绿灯亮起后从 Geary Boulevard 右转进入 Larkin Street，并礼让斑马线上的行人；此时一辆 Toyota Camry 从左侧非转弯车道突然右转切入，与 AV 的左前保险杠发生接触。将 Cruise AV 选为 ego，测试其在转弯让行时应对相邻车辆违规转弯切入的能力。

source_snippets: A Cruise autonomous vehicle ("Cruise AV"), operating in manual mode, was at a complete stop in response to a red light on Geary Boulevard at the intersection with Larkin Street. The Cruise AV began to make a right turn onto Larkin Street on a green light and was yielding to a pedestrian in the crosswalk. Shortly thereafter, a Toyota Camry traveling in a non-turn lane of Geary Boulevard made a right turn in front of the Cruise AV, making contact with the Cruise AV's front left bumper.
evidence.reason: 场景包含两辆移动车辆的交互冲突，ego 正在右转让行，另一车从左侧非转弯车道右转切入导致碰撞，具有测试价值。使用 junction_turn 表达 NPC 在路口转弯冲突，位置为相邻左侧车道，控制为红绿灯。没有量化速度或距离，故不填参数。
